title: Copy Link to Highlight
summary: The reader quotes a passage through the URL's text fragment, and the browser is forbidden by design from telling the page which words were cut.
mechanism: The WICG Text Fragments directive #:~:text= plus CSS ::target-text: the browser scrolls to and paints the reader's quotation while stripping the directive from location.hash, so the page's own JS reads a permanent 0.
references: Roland Barthes, The Death of the Author (1967)
Robert Rauschenberg, This Is a Portrait of Iris Clert If I Say So (1961)
WICG Text Fragments / the #:~:text= fragment directive & CSS ::target-text
